reasoning.description: Think step by step: re-derive what the attached source actually does before judging the assessment. Write that reasoning here — it is not graded directly, but a leading reasoning field measurably improves the quality of constrained JSON output.

agrees.description: Whether you agree with the senior engineer's assessment as stated.

element.description: The specific part of the assessment that is wrong, quoted or closely paraphrased.

why.description: Why it is wrong, citing the attached source.

objections.description: Your objections, if any. Empty when agrees is true.

confidence.description: 0-100: how confident you are in your verdict.
